title: ARPAPED Selective Discovery Key
description: One lookup in the 5-level discovery cascade (2-RULES.md 'Registry contract'): Exact -> Scoped -> Family -> Domain -> Cross-domain. `level` names which lookup this key performs; the fields that matter depend on it. `operation` and `contract_version` are always required.

level.description: Which cascade level this key performs. Exact/Scoped need capability_id; Family needs domain + capability_family; Domain needs domain; Cross-domain needs tags.

operation.description: The contract operation being looked up. Required at every level.

contract_version.description: Required contract version — an exact version for level=exact, a range/'*' otherwise.

implementation_id.description: Optional, level=exact only: pins one specific implementation.

domain.description: Required for level=domain and level=family; the contract's identity.domain.

capability_family.description: Required for level=family, alongside domain; the contract's identity.family. A family is only meaningful within its domain — never looked up by family name alone.

tags.description: Required for level=cross_domain; the contract's discoverability.tags.

capability_type.description: Optional narrowing at any level: capability | connector | service.
